Name: Add Reimon From Ultra Galaxy Mega Monster Battle
Author: fibula527
Description:
Add Reimon And Burst Reimon From Ultra Galaxy Mega Monster Battle As New Pets，When Have 1 Heart Will Sent You Some Little Gift（It will not affect the game progress.）

Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

When You have first pet and Marne allow you to adopt more pet , you can adopt reimon by 500.

So  I  recommend this mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37492]Em's Pet Adoptions[/url] —it can help you see your adorable pets more quickly.[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37492][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37492][/url]
